writeup.key_factor: Showcase pick: strong home team at 9-4-1, in the 1.80-2.20 band at 1.91, with the model's highest reliable home probability of the day; Adin Hill (5-1-0) projected in net.
writeup.risk: New Jersey's Connor Hellebuyck is the projected (unconfirmed) starter after a .944 debut; a confirmed Hellebuyck start lowers the real win probability, and the NHL Elo is still the 2025-26 seed.

writeup.key_factor: Showcase pick: UCF is 4-0 at home, hosts its Space Game (8-1 all-time) with hot QB Keyone Jenkins confirmed as starter (293 yards, 3 TD in the upset of No. 2 BYU), against a Baylor team playing its first game under an interim coach after firing Dave Aranda.
writeup.risk: The raw Elo edge (+17.2) is far above the market's pick'em read (Pinnacle no-vig 47.4% for UCF), so the model's 64.4% is likely overstated; this is a showcase Gold, not a Platinum edge claim. Baylor can also get a new-coach bounce, and UCF must avoid a letdown after the BYU upset.
